counterexample_attempts: Recomputed the target as 2^29-2^20=535,822,336 and the claimed margin as 224.
Recomputed every Rabin congruence and remainder-one certificate over F_2; all hold, so T^15+T+1 is irreducible.
Tried Artin–Schreier/trace degeneracy. Every nonlinear endpoint polynomial has positive odd degree below q, so the cited Weil theorem applies and excludes a constant trace function.
Tried cancellation of the nonlinear leading term by uX or vX; degrees 3, 5, 7, or 9 cannot be cancelled by a linear term.

Constructed all 75 endpoint generators Tr(a x^e), with e in {1,3,5,7,9} and a ranging over the polynomial basis, and evaluated them on all 32,768 field elements. Their binary rank is 75, independently supporting encoder injectivity and final dimension 91.
Tested the nonlinear encoder-kernel case: a zero word would have signed sum q^2, contradicting the bound 1448^2.
Tested P=0 with exactly one of u,v nonzero, both nonzero, and either value of c. A nontrivial endpoint character sum vanishes, so every such word is balanced.
Tested the constant-only cases: c=0 is zero and c=1 is the all-one word.
Checked the diagonal x=y, where P(x)+P(y) cancels. The exact double-sum factorization already includes these coordinates and still gives the claimed global bound.

Exhaustively computed Walsh spectra over every endpoint-linear character for the coefficient-one phases X^3, X^5, X^7, X^9 and all 15 nonempty coefficient-one combinations. The largest tested magnitude was 1,312, below 1,448; no low-weight word appeared.
Tested the scoped ceiling at r=5: the two proper low-degree preimages cannot cover F^5, and the stipulated factorwise certificate then exceeds the 64q budget.
Tested the sparse-graph obstruction at the extremal D=2^14, v=2^16; the Frobenius bound gives lambda^2 at least 3/65535, hence lambda>1/512.
Recomputed the campaign's canonical sorted-key JSON hash and obtained the supplied immutable SHA-256 exactly.

line_audit.claim: The r≤4 ceiling is valid within the expressly scoped factorized generic-Weil template.
line_audit.justification: Odd nonlinear polynomials through degree 2r-1 form an (r-1)-dimensional F-space. Injectivity makes both low-degree preimages proper, so some message has both endpoint degrees at least 2r+1. The upper bound furnished by the stipulated certificate is then at least (2r)^2q; requiring it to be at most 64q forces r≤4. This is a limitation of that certificate, not a lower bound on actual correlations.

line_audit.claim: The sparse one-edge spectral obstruction is correct.
line_audit.justification: From vD=2^30 and D<v, both factors are powers of two, giving D≤2^14 and D/v≤1/4. The normalized nonprincipal eigenvalue satisfies lambda^2≥(v-D)/(D(v-1))>3/65536, hence lambda>1/512. Consequently the stated generic spectral upper bound cannot itself certify bias at most 1/512.

line_audit.claim: The signed coordinate sum factors as W=(-1)^c S(P+uX)S(P+vX).
line_audit.justification: Additivity of the trace character separates the independent x- and y-sums exactly.

line_audit.claim: For P nonzero, both endpoint polynomials satisfy the additive-character Weil hypotheses.
line_audit.justification: Their common leading degree is d in {3,5,7,9}; adding a linear term cannot change it. Thus d<32768 and gcd(d,32768)=1, while psi is nontrivial because Tr(1)=1. These are precisely the hypotheses of [Kowalski, Theorem 3.2](https://people.math.ethz.ch/~kowalski/exponential-sums-elementary.pdf).

line_audit.claim: Each nonlinear endpoint sum has magnitude at most 1,448.
line_audit.justification: The uniform bound is 8sqrt(32768)=1024sqrt(2)=1448.154..., and every sum is an integer because all summands are ±1. Therefore its magnitude is at most 1,448.

line_audit.claim: Every nonlinear word has weight at least 535,822,560.
line_audit.justification: The product bound is 1448^2=2,096,704. Since wt=(2^30-W)/2 and |W| is bounded by that product, wt≥(2^30-2,096,704)/2=535,822,560.

line_audit.claim: Every nonzero linear-only word is balanced.
line_audit.justification: If P=0 and one of u,v is nonzero, multiplication by that coefficient permutes F and the corresponding nontrivial additive-character sum is zero. Thus W=0 for either value of c and the weight is 2^29.

line_audit.claim: The constant and zero cases complete the codeword case split.
line_audit.justification: When P=u=v=0, c=0 gives the zero word and c=1 gives the all-one word. Together with the nonlinear and linear-only cases, this exhausts all parameter tuples.
